local SHIBU_LOGO_ASSET = nil
local function getShiBuLogoAsset()
    if SHIBU_LOGO_ASSET then return SHIBU_LOGO_ASSET end
    if not writefile or not getcustomasset then return nil end

    local ok, asset = pcall(function()
        local path = "shibuhub_logo_96.png"
        writefile(path, SHIBU_LOGO_BYTES)
        return getcustomasset(path)
    end)

    if ok and asset then
        SHIBU_LOGO_ASSET = asset
        return asset
    end
    return nil
end

local function decorateLogo(holder)
    local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    img.Name = "LogoImage"
    img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    img.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
    img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
    img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    img.Parent = holder

    local fallback = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    fallback.Name = "LogoFallback"
    fallback.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    fallback.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    fallback.Text = "SH"
    fallback.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    fallback.TextSize = 17
    fallback.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 255, 250)
    fallback.Parent = holder

    task.defer(function()
        local asset = getShiBuLogoAsset()
        if asset and img.Parent then
            img.Image = asset
            fallback.Visible = false
        else
            img.Visible = false
        end
    end)

    return img
end

local function updateLauncherScale()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    LauncherScale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min((vp.X - 24) / 470, (vp.Y - 80) / 300), 0.68, 1)
end

    b.TextSize = 12
    b.Parent = Nav
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
    c.Parent = b
    return b
end

local function setLauncherTab(active)
    for _, b in ipairs({TabHome, TabScripts, TabSettings}) do
        local on = b == active
        b.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(26, 72, 78) or Color3.fromRGB(14, 34, 47)
        b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(112, 255, 226) or Color3.fromRGB(155, 186, 194)
    end
end
setLauncherTab(TabHome)

TabHome.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setLauncherTab(TabHome)
    WelcomeText.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].welcome
    DescText.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].desc
end)
TabScripts.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setLauncherTab(TabScripts)
    WelcomeText.Text = "ShiBuHub • Steal An Egg"
    DescText.Text = CurrentLang == "vi" and "Nhấn CHẠY SCRIPT để mở bảng điều khiển farm." or "Press RUN SCRIPT to open the farm control panel."
end)
TabSettings.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setLauncherTab(TabSettings)
    WelcomeText.Text = CurrentLang == "vi" and "Cài đặt giao diện" or "Interface settings"
    DescText.Text = CurrentLang == "vi" and "Bạn có thể đổi VI / EN bằng nút ở góc trên." or "Use the VI / EN button in the top-right corner."
end)

-- 3. HÀM XỬ LÝ NGÔN NGỮ
local function UpdateLanguage()
    WelcomeText.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].welcome
    DescText.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].desc
    RunBtn.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].btn_run
    TabHome.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].tab_home
    TabScripts.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].tab_scripts
    TabSettings.Text = Translations[CurrentLang].tab_settings
end

LangBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if CurrentLang == "vi" then
        CurrentLang = "en"
    else
        CurrentLang = "vi"
    end
    UpdateLanguage()
end)

-- 4. NHÚNG EGG STEALER PRO V3.1 (CHẠY KHI BẤM NÚT)
RunBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui.Enabled = false
    -- ==========================================
    -- EGG STEALER PRO V3.1 (FULL CODE)
    -- ==========================================

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local G = getgenv() or _G
    G.EggStealerPro = G.EggStealerPro or {}
    local S = G.EggStealerPro

    -- Config
    S.Config = {
        AutoSteal = false,
        AutoReturnBase = false,
        TeleportReturn = false,
        AutoHatch = false,
        AutoTreadmill = false,
        AutoFeedMonster = false,
        AutoClaimChests = false,
        AutoUpgradeTreadmill = false,
        AutoSell = false,
        EvasiveRun = true,
        FastMove = true,
        ProtectRarities = true,
        WebhookEnabled = false,
        WebhookUrl = "",
        BaseCF = nil,
        StopDistance = 5.5,
        WalkTimeout = 30,
        RarityTargets = {Common=false, Uncommon=false, Rare=false, Epic=false, Legendary=true, Mythic=true, Cosmic=true, Secret=true, Divine=true, Eternal=true},
        FeedRarities = {Common=false, Uncommon=false, Rare=true, Epic=true, Legendary=true, Mythic=false, Cosmic=false, Secret=false, Divine=false, Eternal=false},
    }

    -- TELEPORT FUNCTION
    local function teleportToPosition(targetPos)
        local _, root = getCharacter()
        if not root then return false end
        local current = root.Position
        local dist = (targetPos - current).Magnitude
        if dist < 5 then return true end

        local steps = math.max(1, math.ceil(dist / 25))
        local stepVec = (targetPos - current) / steps
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        for i = 1, steps do
            local pos = current + stepVec * i
            pos = pos + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2)
            local tween = TweenService:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(0.06, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)})
            tween:Play()
            tween.Completed:Wait()
            if hum and i % 2 == 0 then
                hum.Jump = true
                task.wait(0.02)
            end
            task.wait(0.04)
        end
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
        return true
    end

    -- UI CREATION
    local function createGui()
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "ShiBuHubControl"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

        local main = Instance.new("Frame")
        main.Name = "Main"
        main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 440)
        main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -260, 0.5, -220)
        main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 17, 27)
        main.BorderSizePixel = 0
        main.Parent = gui

        local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        uiScale.Parent = main
        local function updateScale()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local vp = cam.ViewportSize
            uiScale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min((vp.X - 24) / 520, (vp.Y - 70) / 440), 0.62, 1)
        end
        updateScale()
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then
            workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateScale)
        end

        local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
        mainCorner.Parent = main

        local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        mainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(57, 226, 206)
        mainStroke.Thickness = 1.5
        mainStroke.Transparency = 0.18
        mainStroke.Parent = main

        local mainGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        mainGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(8, 25, 34)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(7, 13, 23))
        })
        mainGradient.Rotation = 30
        mainGradient.Parent = main

        local header = Instance.new("Frame")
        header.Name = "Header"
        header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64)
        header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        header.Parent = main

        local logoHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
        logoHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44)
        logoHolder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10)
        logoHolder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 51, 59)
        logoHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
        logoHolder.Parent = header
        local logoCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        logoCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 13)
        logoCorner.Parent = logoHolder
        local logoStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        logoStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(73, 243, 215)
        logoStroke.Thickness = 1.4
        logoStroke.Transparency = 0.15
        logoStroke.Parent = logoHolder
        decorateLogo(logoHolder)

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 27)
        title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 9)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "ShiBu HUB"
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 255, 252)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        title.TextSize = 20
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.Parent = header

        local subtitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 18)
        subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(71, 35)
        subtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        subtitle.Text = "STEAL AN EGG  •  FARM CONTROL"
        subtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(101, 169, 180)
        subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        subtitle.TextSize = 10
        subtitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        subtitle.Parent = header

        local minimize = Instance.new("TextButton")

                    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                    main.Position = UDim2.new(
                        startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                        startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                    )
                end
            end)

    -- CORE FUNCTIONS
    local Remote = {}
    local function getRemotes()
        local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages") and ReplicatedStorage.Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
        if not net then return end
        Remote.EggSnapshot = net:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFieldEggSnapshot")
        Remote.MonsterSnapshot = net:FindFirstChild("RF/MonsterParasite/AskSnapshot")
        Remote.MonsterFeed = net:FindFirstChild("RF/MonsterParasite/AskFeed")
        Remote.MonsterChestTake = net:FindFirstChild("RF/MonsterParasite/AskChestTake")
        Remote.MonsterChestClaim = net:FindFirstChild("RF/MonsterParasite/AskChestClaim")
        Remote.Hatch = net:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskHatch")
        Remote.HatchFinish = net:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFinishHatch")
        Remote.TreadRaise = net:FindFirstChild("RF/Treadmill/AskTierRaise")
        Remote.SatchelSale = net:FindFirstChild("RF/Haul/OfferFullSatchelSale")
        Remote.WearBest = net:FindFirstChild("RF/Haul/WearBest")
        Remote.AwayCollect = net:FindFirstChild("RF/AwayEarnings/AskCollect")
        Remote.PlotState = net:FindFirstChild("RF/Homestead/AskState")
    end
    getRemotes()

    local function invoke(remote, ...)
        if not remote then return false end
        local ok, res = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, ...)
        return ok and res
    end

    local function getCharacter()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not c or not c.Parent then return nil, nil end
        return c, c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function closeEnough(pos1, pos2, dist)
        dist = dist or 6
        return (pos1 - pos2).Magnitude <= dist
    end

    local function getRarity(rec)
        local r = rec.Rarity or rec.RarityName or rec.Tier
        if type(r) == "string" then return r end
        return nil
    end

    local function readEggs()
        if not Remote.EggSnapshot then return {} end
        local ok, snap = pcall(Remote.EggSnapshot.InvokeServer, Remote.EggSnapshot)
        if not ok or type(snap) ~= "table" then return {} end
        local eggs = {}
        local function collect(t)
            if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
            if t.Uid and (t.State == "Slot" or t.State == "Dropped" or t.State == nil) then
                table.insert(eggs, t)
            end
            for _, v in pairs(t) do if type(v) == "table" then collect(v) end end
        end
        collect(snap)
        return eggs
    end

    -- Walking
    local function walkTo(pos, stopDist, timeout)
        stopDist = stopDist or S.Config.StopDistance or 5.5
        timeout = timeout or S.Config.WalkTimeout or 30
        local char, root = getCharacter()
        if not char or not root then return false end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return false end

        if closeEnough(root.Position, pos, stopDist) then return true end

        local startTime = os.clock()
        local lastPos = root.Position
        local stuckCount = 0
        local waypoints = nil
        local wpIndex = 1

        local function buildPath()
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius=2, AgentHeight=5, AgentCanJump=true, WaypointSpacing=5})
            local ok, err = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, pos) end)
            if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                local pts = path:GetWaypoints()
                if #pts > 0 then
                    waypoints = pts
                    wpIndex = 1
                    return true
                end
            end
            waypoints = nil
            return false
        end

        while os.clock() - startTime < timeout do
            if not root.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end

            if closeEnough(root.Position, pos, stopDist) then
                hum:MoveTo(root.Position)
                return true
            end

            local now = os.clock()
            local moved = (root.Position - lastPos).Magnitude
            if moved < 0.8 then stuckCount = stuckCount + 1 else stuckCount = 0 end
            lastPos = root.Position

            local target = pos
            if S.Config.FastMove and stuckCount < 3 then
                -- direct
            elseif not waypoints or stuckCount >= 3 then
                buildPath()
                stuckCount = 0
            end

            if waypoints and waypoints[wpIndex] then
                local wp = waypoints[wpIndex]
                if closeEnough(root.Position, wp.Position, 4) then
                    wpIndex = wpIndex + 1
                    wp = waypoints[wpIndex]
                end
                if wp then
                    target = wp.Position
                    if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                        hum.Jump = true
                    end
                else
                    waypoints = nil
                end
            end

            -- Evasive
            if S.Config.EvasiveRun then
                local threats = {}
                for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and obj ~= char then
                        local hp = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hp and obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health > 0 then
                            local dist = (root.Position - hp.Position).Magnitude
                            if dist < 20 and dist > 1 then
                                table.insert(threats, hp.Position)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #threats > 0 then
                    local avg = Vector3.zero
                    for _, p in ipairs(threats) do avg = avg + p end
                    avg = avg / #threats
                    local away = (root.Position - avg).Unit * 8
                    target = root.Position + (target - root.Position).Unit * 10 + away
                end
            end

            hum:MoveTo(target)
            task.wait(0.12)
        end
        return false
    end

    -- MAIN STEAL
    local scanned = 0
    local picked = 0
    local lastAction = "Ready"
    local currentTarget = "None"
    local farmBusy = false

    local function sendWebhook(title, desc)
        if not S.Config.WebhookEnabled or S.Config.WebhookUrl == "" then return end
        local data = {username="EggStealerPro", embeds={{title=title, description=desc, color=0x00ccff}}}
        local body = HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
        local request = syn and syn.request or http_request or request
        if request then
            pcall(function()
                request({Url=S.Config.WebhookUrl, Method="POST", Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"}, Body=body})
            end)
        end
    end

    local function getBestEgg()
        local eggs = readEggs()
        scanned = scanned + #eggs
        local targets = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(eggs) do
            local r = getRarity(e)
            if r and S.Config.RarityTargets[r] then
                table.insert(targets, e)
            end
        end
        local rankOrder = {Divine=10, Eternal=9, Secret=8, Cosmic=7, Mythic=6, Legendary=5, Epic=4, Rare=3, Uncommon=2, Common=1}
        table.sort(targets, function(a,b)
            local ra = rankOrder[getRarity(a)] or 0
            local rb = rankOrder[getRarity(b)] or 0
            if ra ~= rb then return ra > rb end
            local _, root = getCharacter()
            if root then
                local da = (root.Position - (a.CFrame and a.CFrame.Position or Vector3.new(0,0,0))).Magnitude
                local db = (root.Position - (b.CFrame and b.CFrame.Position or Vector3.new(0,0,0))).Magnitude
                return da < db
            end
            return false
        end)
        return targets[1]
    end

    local function stealEgg()
        local target = getBestEgg()
        if not target then
            currentTarget = "None"
            lastAction = "Searching..."
            return false
        end
        local uid = target.Uid
        local rarity = getRarity(target)
        currentTarget = rarity or "Unknown"
        lastAction = "Moving to " .. (rarity or "egg")

        local pos = target.CFrame and target.CFrame.Position or target.Position
        if not pos then
            local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient") and workspace.AreaEggSlotsClient:FindFirstChild(tostring(uid), true)
            if obj then
                local part = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if part then pos = part.Position end
            end
        end
        if not pos then
            lastAction = "No position found"
            return false
        end

        if not walkTo(pos, 6, 25) then
            lastAction = "Failed to reach egg"
            return false
        end

        local function findPrompt()
            local smart = workspace:FindFirstChild("SmartPromptPart")
            if smart then
                for _, d in ipairs(smart:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Name:find("CarryAreaEgg") then
                        return d
                    end
                end
            end
            local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient") and workspace.AreaEggSlotsClient:FindFirstChild(tostring(uid), true)
            if obj then
                for _, d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return d end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local prompt = findPrompt()
        if not prompt then
            task.wait(0.5)
            prompt = findPrompt()
        end
        if not prompt then
            lastAction = "No prompt found"
            return false
        end

        lastAction = "Stealing..."
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt)
            else prompt:InputHoldBegin(); task.wait(0.5); prompt:InputHoldEnd() end
        end)
        if not ok then
            lastAction = "Prompt failed"
            return false
        end

        task.wait(0.8)
        local still = readEggs()
        local stillHas = false
        for _, e in ipairs(still) do
            if e.Uid == uid then stillHas = true; break end
        end
        if stillHas then
            prompt = findPrompt()
            if prompt then
                pcall(function()
                    if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                    else prompt:InputHoldBegin(); task.wait(0.5); prompt:InputHoldEnd() end
                end)
                task.wait(0.8)
                still = readEggs()
                stillHas = false
                for _, e in ipairs(still) do
                    if e.Uid == uid then stillHas = true; break end
                end
            end
            if stillHas then
                lastAction = "Steal failed"
                return false
            end
        end

        picked = picked + 1
        lastAction = "Picked " .. (rarity or "egg")
        sendWebhook("Egg Stolen", string.format("Rarity: %s\nUID: %s", rarity or "Unknown", uid))

        if S.Config.AutoReturnBase and S.Config.BaseCF then
            if S.Config.TeleportReturn then
                lastAction = "Teleporting to base"
                teleportToPosition(S.Config.BaseCF.Position)
            else
                lastAction = "Returning to base"
                walkTo(S.Config.BaseCF.Position, 7, 20)
            end
        end

        return true
    end

    -- MONSTER FEED & CHEST
    local function getMonster()
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("MonsterParasiteMonsters")
        if not folder then return nil end
        for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if m:IsA("Model") then
                local owner = m:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
                if tonumber(owner) == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    return m
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function getMonsterPosition()
        local m = getMonster()
        if not m then return nil end
        local part = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
        if part then return part.Position end
        return nil
    end

    local function feedMonster()
        if not Remote.MonsterSnapshot or not Remote.MonsterFeed then return false end
        local snap = invoke(Remote.MonsterSnapshot)
        if not snap or not snap.Event or not snap.Event.Active then
            lastAction = "Monster not active"
            return false
        end

        local eggs = readEggs()
        local candidate = nil
        for _, e in ipairs(eggs) do
            local r = getRarity(e)
            if r and S.Config.FeedRarities[r] then
                if S.Config.ProtectRarities and S.Config.RarityTargets[r] then
                    -- skip
                else
                    candidate = e
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not candidate then
            lastAction = "No feed egg"
            return false
        end

        local uid = candidate.Uid
        local pos = candidate.CFrame and candidate.CFrame.Position or candidate.Position
        if not pos then
            local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient") and workspace.AreaEggSlotsClient:FindFirstChild(tostring(uid), true)
            if obj then
                local part = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if part then pos = part.Position end
            end
        end
        if not pos then return false end

        if not walkTo(pos, 6, 20) then return false end
        local function findPrompt2()
            local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient") and workspace.AreaEggSlotsClient:FindFirstChild(tostring(uid), true)
            if obj then
                for _, d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return d end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local prompt = findPrompt2()
        if not prompt then task.wait(0.5); prompt = findPrompt2() end
        if not prompt then return false end
        pcall(function()
            if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt)
            else prompt:InputHoldBegin(); task.wait(0.5); prompt:InputHoldEnd() end
        end)
        task.wait(0.8)
        local still = readEggs()
        local found = false
        for _, e in ipairs(still) do if e.Uid == uid then found = true; break end end
        if found then return false end

        local monsterPos = getMonsterPosition()
        if not monsterPos then
            lastAction = "Monster not found"
            return false
        end
        if not walkTo(monsterPos, 8, 20) then return false end

        local ok, res = pcall(Remote.MonsterFeed.InvokeServer, Remote.MonsterFeed)
        if not ok then return false end
        if type(res) == "table" and res.Success then
            lastAction = "Fed monster"
            sendWebhook("Monster Fed", string.format("Charge: %s → %s", res.PreviousCharge or 0, res.Charge or 0))
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function claimChest()
        if not Remote.MonsterChestTake or not Remote.MonsterChestClaim then return false end
        local okTake = invoke(Remote.MonsterChestTake)
        if not okTake or type(okTake) ~= "table" or not okTake.Success then return false end
        task.wait(2.5)
        local okClaim = invoke(Remote.MonsterChestClaim)
        if okClaim and type(okClaim) == "table" and okClaim.Success then
            lastAction = "Chest claimed"
            sendWebhook("Chest Claimed", "Reward: " .. tostring(okClaim.Reward and okClaim.Reward.DisplayName or "unknown"))
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- TREADMILL & HATCH
    local function getOwnPlot()
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil end
        if Remote.PlotState then
            local state = invoke(Remote.PlotState)
            if state and state.OwnersBySlot then
                for slot, owner in pairs(state.OwnersBySlot) do
                    if owner == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                        return plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(slot))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function treadmillWork()
        local plot = getOwnPlot()
        if not plot then
            lastAction = "No own plot"
            return false
        end
        local belt = plot:FindFirstChild("TreadmillBottom", true)
        if not belt or not belt:IsA("BasePart") then
            belt = plot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end
        if not belt then return false end
        local pos = belt.Position
        if not walkTo(pos, 5, 15) then return false end
        local _, root = getCharacter()
        if root then
            local dir = belt.CFrame.LookVector
            local offset = dir * (math.random() > 0.5 and 2 or -2)
            local target = pos + offset
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum:MoveTo(target) end
        end
        lastAction = "Treadmill training"
        return true
    end

    local function hatchEggs()
        if not Remote.Hatch or not Remote.HatchFinish then return false end
        local eggs = readEggs()
        local count = 0
        for _, e in ipairs(eggs) do
            if e.Uid then
                if invoke(Remote.Hatch, {Uid=e.Uid}) then
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    invoke(Remote.HatchFinish, {Uid=e.Uid})
                    count = count + 1
                end
            end
        end
        if count > 0 then
            lastAction = "Hatched " .. count .. " eggs"
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- SCHEDULER
    local function scheduler()
        local lastSteal = 0
        local lastMonster = 0
        local lastChest = 0
        local lastTread = 0
        local lastHatch = 0
        local lastSell = 0
        local lastUpgrade = 0

        while task.wait(0.2) do
            if not S.Gui or not S.Gui.Parent then break end

            if farmBusy then continue end
            farmBusy = true

            local now = os.clock()

            if S.Config.AutoSteal and now - lastSteal > 2 then
                stealEgg()
                lastSteal = now
                task.wait(0.5)
            end

            if S.Config.AutoFeedMonster and now - lastMonster > 3 then
                feedMonster()
                lastMonster = now
                task.wait(0.5)
            end

            if S.Config.AutoClaimChests and now - lastChest > 5 then
                claimChest()
                lastChest = now
                task.wait(0.5)
            end

            if S.Config.AutoTreadmill and now - lastTread > 2 then
                treadmillWork()
                lastTread = now
                task.wait(0.5)
            end

            if S.Config.AutoHatch and now - lastHatch > 10 then
                hatchEggs()
                lastHatch = now
                task.wait(0.5)
            end

            if S.Config.AutoUpgradeTreadmill and Remote.TreadRaise and now - lastUpgrade > 30 then
                local ok = invoke(Remote.TreadRaise, "some_treadmill_id")
                if ok then lastAction = "Treadmill upgraded" end
                lastUpgrade = now
            end

            if S.Config.AutoSell and Remote.SatchelSale and now - lastSell > 20 then
                invoke(Remote.SatchelSale)
                lastSell = now
            end

            farmBusy = false
        end
    end

    -- START EGG STEALER PRO
    local function startEggStealer()
        local gui, statusLabel, targetLabel, statsLabel = createGui()
        S.Gui = gui

        task.spawn(function()
            while gui and gui.Parent do
                task.wait(1)
                statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. lastAction
                targetLabel.Text = "Target: " .. currentTarget
                statsLabel.Text = string.format("Scanned: %d | Picked: %d", scanned, picked)
            end
        end)

        task.spawn(scheduler)

        -- Auto-rejoin
        game:OnTeleport(function(state)
            if state == Enum.TeleportState.Teleporting then
                task.wait(3)
                TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
            end
        end)

        -- Save base position
        local function saveBase()
            local _, root = getCharacter()
            if root then S.Config.BaseCF = root.CFrame end
        end
        task.wait(2)
        saveBase()
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(saveBase)

        print("Egg Stealer Pro v3.1 started. Toggle Teleport Return in SETTINGS.")
    end

    -- Gọi start
    startEggStealer()

    -- ==========================================
    -- KẾT THÚC EGG STEALER PRO
    -- ==========================================
end)

-- 5. HIỂN THỊ GUI
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
